items.title: Unfinished LP settlement rejects stock deposits and withdrawals
items.description: The LP manager rejects stock deposits and withdrawals because it checks W transfers instead of U; production Wrapped LP remains unfinished.
gates: ALLOWS: Registry/SBT/issuer/tick/deadline checks accept an eligible quote-only position; zero W delta passes _settle; normal wrapped swap creates a positive W position delta.
ALLOWS: The compiled source exposes this path with normal roles and ordinary price movement; manifest false is a documented release boundary, not an on-chain entry guard.
ALLOWS: An eligible unprivileged trader calls swapExactInput; the existing LP owner then encounters the incorrect W receipt check.
CONFIRMED: Positive stock principal or fees prevents normal or forced stock withdrawal and keeps the position active. No permanent-loss or deployed-victim claim is made.
items.confidence_basis: 100 minus 10 for the specified but achievable single-sided LP state.
items.scope_caveat: Compiled retained LP implementation only. Current repository explicitly defers production Wrapped LP and has no demonstrated production deployment.

fix_options.label: A — block unfinished LP entries
B — settle stocks in U and validate the LP wrapper
C — block new stock position creation
D — settle stocks in U; authorize the LP wrapper before use

items.title: Issuer inactivity raises the cost of legal-share conversion
items.code_smells: The adapter calls an issuer conversion method whose reference implementation repeats fee arithmetic for each elapsed period.
items.description: A trader faces higher swap gas after long issuer inactivity; we have not verified the admitted token's fee settings or a failed swap.
gates: ALLOWS: Hook requires issuer conversion for the stock delta; the reference issuer view loops once per elapsed period, and Wrapped U transfers do not checkpoint it.
UNCERTAIN: No actual admitted production issuer configuration, bounded inactivity proof, or material gas failure is supplied. The reference default zero fee skips the loop.
items.promotion: Convergence establishes the same external reference loop, but no concrete production failure or material impact is proved. Shared-rules requires a LEAD when concrete proof is absent; repeated assumptions do not supply the missing configuration.
